title: Decision review
summary: Gather the open decisions on a piece of work, prepare each with options and a recommendation, and walk the person through them one at a time. What they decide is recorded with who raised it and why.

library.summary: Gather what is waiting on you, prepare each decision with options and a recommendation, and record what you pick.
library.prompt: Walk me through the open decisions on {{what: a document, a dataset in data/, or "the Allowances launch"}} using the decision-review skill.

inputs.name: source
inputs.hint: Where the open questions are: documents, datasets with items waiting on the person, or this conversation.

launchers.label: Review open decisions
launchers.prompt: Walk me through the open decisions on {path}.

when: Open questions or decisions are piling up and the person wants to work through them
The person is preparing for a steering or review meeting and asks what they need to decide
not_when: One quick choice the person can make in a line
routing.needs: Where the open questions are: documents, datasets with items waiting on the person, or this conversation
routing.offer: There are several open decisions here. Decision review prepares each with options and a recommendation and walks you through them one at a time.

start: Walk me through the open decisions on the payments work.
Run a decision review before steering.
offer: Steering is tomorrow and I don't know what I'm supposed to decide.
open: Should I push back on the date or the scope?

invariants: Every decision records who raised it and why
